background: Barclays PLC is the listed holding company of the Barclays group, a UK universal bank with a large transatlantic corporate and investment bank alongside UK retail banking and international cards.
synthesis: Rated A- on average across all three, the weakest of them at BBB+, all three on a stable outlook, the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 19 May 2023; as a holding company it rates below its operating banks. The group's ratios are strong against UK majors, with CET1 of 14.3% in the top quarter and leverage of 4.9%, LCR of 158% and NSFR of 136% all above the peer median. The one move to note is LCR, down 20 points since 30 Jun 2025, while the other ratios have held flat. No rating action has been taken in the last 90 days.
